feeds.title: I Heart Umami
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to I Heart Umami. I'm ChihYu Smith, found of the easy homemade meal planning program and author of the Asian Paleo Cookbook. I share Healthy Asian Dinner Recipes that are also Paleo, gluten-free, and/or low carb. My recipes are easy to prep, with big flavor.

feeds.title: KetoforIndia Blog
feeds.description: My name is Priya Dogra, an Indian Keto coach and nutritionist. This is my personal story of success, of getting fit and losing weight, by switching to a Ketogenic lifestyle. The journey has inspired me to share my story with all those looking for inspiration to lose weight and get healthy again.

feeds.title: Keto India Blog
feeds.description: A blog covering inspiring transformation stories, delicious Keto Recipes, facts about the Keto Diet and the science of Keto. Keto India is a ketogenic consulting company that helps clients better manage their weight loss through a personalized Ketogenic diet protocol.

feeds.title: LCA recipes
feeds.description: Find easy Healthy Low Carb recipes from around the world that we love to make and eat in our everyday life. A collection of healthy low-carb Asian-inspired recipes. All recipes include step-by-step pictures that you can easily make in your own home!
